0.2.0.summary: Milim 0.2.0 brings GitHub pull requests, clearer account runtimes, and editable Google Workspace files into the local development workflow.

items.title: Review and merge GitHub pull requests in Milim
items.description: Open a pull request from the Git inspector and keep the review beside your coding thread.
details: Track checks, approvals, and merge readiness
Read and reply to review comments

items.title: Update coding-agent CLIs from Milim
items.description: Manage Codex, Claude, OpenCode, and Pi from the Providers screen.
details: Run CLI updates without opening a terminal
Use the same approval modes across runtimes

items.title: Open and edit Google Workspace files
items.description: Keep selected Docs, Sheets, and Slides beside the conversation.
details: Edit Docs text and Sheets cells in place
Autosave supported changes back to Google
